table.retrieve:
SELECT  
	itemname = case printable when  0  then ltrim(str(item.icode)) + ' Counter Sale'   else item.name end,
	itemcounter=1,
	reprintdate=getdate(), 
	users.username,  
	accounts.name, 
	headerno =max(saleledgermodified.headerno),
	saleinvcode = dbo.saleledgermodified.saleinvcode,   
	date = Case :ai_printdate When 1 Then dbo.saleledgermodified.originaldate When 2 Then dbo.saleledgermodified.date When 3 Then dbo.saleledgermodified.Billingdate  End, 
	discperc = dbo.saleledgermodified.discperc,   
	misccharges = dbo.saleledgermodified.misccharges,   
	flatdisc = dbo.saleledgermodified.flatdisc,   
	salestax = dbo.saleledgermodified.salestax,   
	custcode = dbo.saleledgermodified.custcode,   
	remarks = dbo.saleledgermodified.remarks,
	custrefno = dbo.saleledgermodified.custrefno,	
	icode = dbo.saledetailmodified.icode,   
	gcode =dbo.saledetailmodified.gcode,
	salecatcode = max(saleledgermodified.salecatcode),
	Id        = MAX(dbo.saledetailmodified.IDENTITYCOL),     
	looseqty  = sum(saledetailmodified.looseqty), 
	packqty   = sum(saledetailmodified.packqty), 
	packunits = max(saledetailmodified.packunits), 
	saleprice = max(saledetailmodified.saleprice), 
	rate      = max(saledetailmodified.rate),
	salestax  = max(saledetailmodified.salestax),   
	discperc  = max(saledetailmodified.discperc), 
	customername = '                                  '  ,
	itemflatdisc  = max(saledetailmodified.itemflatdisc),
	unitsalestax  = max(saledetailmodified.unitsalestax),
	gstperc       = max(saledetailmodified.gstperc),
	invgstperc    = max(saleledgermodified.invgstperc1),
	reprintcounter = max(saleledgermodified.reprintingcounter),
	patient=max(patient.name),
	patientreg=max(patient.regno),
	doctor=max(doctors.name)
	
FROM 
	saleledgermodified
	LEFT OUTER JOIN patient ON (saleledgermodified.patientcode = patient.patientcode) 
	LEFT OUTER JOIN doctors ON (saleledgermodified.doctCode = doctors.doctcode),   
	dbo.saledetailmodified,  
	item, 
	customer, 
	accounts,
	users
	
WHERE (dbo.saleledgermodified.saleinvcode IN (Select SaleInvCode From SaleLedgerModified Where SaleInvCode Between :ar_SInvCode And :ar_LInvCode And :ar_dateorinv = 0 ) 
	OR
	dbo.saleledgermodified.saleinvcode IN (Select SaleInvCode From SaleLedgerModified Where Date Between :ar_StartDate And :ar_EndDate And :ar_dateorinv = 1 ) 				
	) AND
	( dbo.saleledgermodified.custcode IN (:aa_custcode)) AND 
	( dbo.saleledgermodified.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetailmodified.saleinvcode ) AND 
	( dbo.saleledgermodified.custcode = dbo.customer.custcode ) AND 
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
	( dbo.saleledgermodified.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND
	( saledetailmodified.icode = item.icode )
GROUP BY 
	saleledgermodified.saleinvcode, 
	saleledgermodified.originaldate,
	saleledgermodified.date, 
	saleledgermodified.billingdate,
	/*saleledgermodified.headerno,*/
	saleledgermodified.custcode, 
	saleledgermodified.discperc, 
	saleledgermodified.flatdisc, 
	saleledgermodified.misccharges, 
	saleledgermodified.salestax, 
	saleledgermodified.remarks,
	saleledgermodified.custrefno, 
	saledetailmodified.icode, 
	saledetailmodified.rowgroup,
	saledetailmodified.gcode, 
	item.name,
	item.icode,
	item.printable, 
	accounts.name,
	dbo.users.username
ORDER BY 
	saleledgermodified.saleinvcode,
	MAX(dbo.saledetailmodified.IDENTITYCOL)

objects.name: c_sumitemleveltaxval
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round(looseqty * unitsalestax ,2) for group 1)

objects.name: c_totaltax
objects.expression: Round(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - saleledger_discperc * 0.01) ,2) -  saleledger_flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + sum(c_salestaxval for all) , 0)

objects.name: c_invsalestaxval
objects.expression: Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - saleledger_discperc * 0.01),2) -  saleledger_flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: /*Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  saleledger_flatdisc  +  saleledger_misccharges  + saleledger_salestax , 0)*/Round(Sum (  c_netamount for group 1 ) -  saleledger_flatdisc  +  saleledger_misccharges  + saleledger_salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for group 1 ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - saleledger_discperc * 0.01) , 2) -  saleledger_flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0)
